admission.justification: Keep parent-only plain arrows, browser-owned modifier chords and fresh holds after every selection episode, including hidden transitions. A fold click is not a fold-arrow feature. The alternatives are documented previous/rule-question choices, not invented design-discussion history.

alternatives.option: Let parent/fold clicks and existing state-changing plain parent arrows override automatic chosen-document reveal for only the current selection episode, without changing the chosen document.
alternatives.reason: D309 and the 2026-10-17T00:34:16+02:00 C2 ruling deliberately replace the old MIK-R144 selected-ancestor immunity; R14-F01 fixes release lifetime without broadening the keyboard path.

alternatives.option: Keep the old unconditional chosen-document hold and ignore an attempted close.
alternatives.reason: D309 gives deliberate disclosure action precedence. C2 explicitly replaces the held-parent arrow prohibition, while completed folds still receive no arrow handler.
alternatives.reconsider_when: A new developer ruling explicitly requires the chosen document to remain visible despite an intentional close.
